title: The Three Things and Seven Reasons for Adam's Forming
description: What was bestowed upon the First Man under three heads: the icon set upon him (sealed before the Ambassador's image), the structure molded into him (after the firstborn of heaven and the Five Sons), and the cosmic teaching sealed within him (houses of zodiac, stars, days, years). Then the seven reasons why he was so fashioned, moving from his role as bearer of the Ambassador's likeness through his perilous capture of the Light to his final dignity as head and king of the creatures.
